messages:
alex: CI red on master: hosted API integ tests failing. toolcall_stream_test and auth_stream_test failing with timeouts + 401s. anyone seen this?
ci-bot: [CI] Job #8421 failed on linux-x86: hosted-integration (tests: toolcall_stream_test, auth_stream_test). first failure: toolcall_stream_test (timeout 60s). https://ci.redwood/8421 :rotating_light:
jen: reran locally against staging hosted - got same 401 on /v1/toolcall/stream when using service token from creds: 'error: invalid_token'
sanjay: can someone bisect? suspecting changes in http-client pooling from last week
maya: i can take a bisect. quick question: are the test harness tokens rotated? @jen did you use the CI job token or personal service token?
jen: used CI job token via ./scripts/ci-token fetch. i can paste curl
jen: curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN' -X POST https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall/stream -d '{"model":"rwd-xl","input":"ping"}'
jen: response headers: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error=\"invalid_token\"
sanjay: interesting — we also see intermittent timeouts for streaming in the logs. maybe upstream gateway started rejecting large keepalive frames.
ci-bot: [CI] Attached test logs: /artifacts/8421/toolcall_stream_test.log
alex: log snippet:
alex: ```
2026-03-16T14:22:10Z ERROR transport: write tcp 10.0.4.5:43210->10.1.1.2:443: write: connection reset by peer
2026-03-16T14:22:15Z WARN  auth: token validation failed: token not found in cache
```
maya: i'll start a bisect across master..HEAD, running integration-only, skipping heavy stuff; if it's a regression we can revert or hotfix.
rachael: FYI: I saw a change in the hosted auth cache last thursday — PR #3421 changed cache eviction from 10m -> 30s. could be related.
sanjay: nice catch. @maya if bisect points to #3421 we should revert and redeploy auth-cache config
maya: starting bisect now. CC: @alex i'll post the culprit commit or bisection URL when done
ops-bot: [ops] kicked off a smoke rerun on prod-proxy in eu-west-1 to validate streaming connections
jen: while bisect runs: quick workaround in CI -> bump toolcall_stream_test timeout to 120s? would buy time but masks root cause
alex: don't widen timeout unless we also guard auth failures; increased timeouts will hide 401 regressions
maya: bisect update: narrowed down to commit abc1234 (merge of PR #3421). reproduces locally. run: git bisect visualize -> https://ci.redwood/bs/123
maya: commit message: 'reduce auth cache TTL to improve freshness' changed cache TTL to 30s
sanjay: we should revert that change, but also add more robust token refresh to the gateway
rachael: opening revert PR now: #3509
jen: CI rerun after revert? anyone start a 1-off job
ops-bot: [CI] Triggered job #8426: integration-hosted (after revert PR #3509).
ci-bot: [CI] Job #8426 passed: integration-hosted. :tada: all green
alex: awesome. thanks @maya @rachael @sanjay for the fast turnaround. let's follow up with a quick postmortem about auth cache TTL + streaming behavior
maya: :thumbsup: will write a 1-pager and add to eng-infra channel tomorrow
